items.h: Get ahead of fantasy football's Week 8 bye-mageddon by stashing these players today
items.s: Stash these players ahead of Week 8, when six NFL teams' worth of fantasy football stars will be on bye.

items.h: Mooney (hamstring) is listed as a limited participant on Wednesday's estimated practice report, Marc Raimondi of ESPN.com reports.
items.s: The Falcons didn't practice Wednesday, but the listing suggests Mooney will participate later this week. He hasn't practiced since injuring his hamstring during a Week 4 win over Washington.
